conferenceQuality.method: For each verified D-I interconference game with a known venue, compare its result to the chance an average D-I team would win against the same opponent at that venue. The opponent’s Colley rating excludes that game. Conference win surplus is observed wins minus those expected wins across the rated games.
conferenceQuality.sampleNote: Fewer than 10 rated games is a small sample. Games at unconfirmed venues count toward the record but not win surplus.
